hero.title: From idea to production: built, tested, deployed and maintained by AI
hero.subtitle: Describe your app in plain words. KRunAI’s AI team creates it, checks it, launches it in your own cloud and keeps it running. No technical knowledge needed.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Four steps from a rough idea to an app your customers can use.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: Tell our AI manager what you need. It writes a clear plan and builds the app.

steps.title: Test
steps.text: Every feature is checked automatically before you see it, so bugs are caught early.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.text: The finished app goes live in your own AWS account. You stay the owner.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.text: We monitor, fix and improve the app after launch. Ask for changes any time.

process.title: What working with us looks like
steps: You describe your idea in a chat with the AI manager.
You receive a technical specification and approve it.
The AI team develops and tests the app.
The app is launched in your cloud.
Support and improvements continue after launch.

benefits.title: Why KRunAI
benefits.intro: Everything a customer expects from a development studio, without the waiting and the jargon.

items.title: Speed
items.text: First working version in days, not months.

items.title: Any complexity
items.text: From a simple landing page to a multi-service platform.

items.title: Automated testing
items.text: Each change is tested automatically before release.

items.title: Your own AWS cloud
items.text: The app runs in your account. No vendor lock-in, full control of data.

items.title: Plain language
items.text: We explain everything without technical jargon, at any stage.

examples.title: What you can build
examples.intro: A few typical projects. If yours is not on the list, just ask.

items.title: Websites
items.text: Company sites, landing pages and portfolios.

items.title: Internal services
items.text: Tools that automate your team’s routine work.

items.title: Bots
items.text: Chat bots for customer support and sales.

items.title: Dashboards
items.text: Live reports on sales, operations or users.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.answer: No. You talk to the AI manager in plain language and get answers without jargon. You only decide what you want.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A simple site can be ready in a few days. Complex products take longer; you get a timeline when you approve the specification.

items.question: Who owns the app and the code?
items.answer: You do. The app runs in your own AWS account, and you hold the access and the data.

items.question: How do you make sure it works?
items.answer: Automated tests run on every change. Nothing is released until the checks pass.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We monitor the app, fix problems and add new features on request.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the scope. Send a request and we will reply with an estimate.

contact.title: Tell us about your idea
